SMART_PLAYLISTS.SCHEDULE_SECTION_DOC: All of Volumio's standard music sources (Internal Storage, USB, NAS) are scanned automatically - no path configuration needed. Missing sources are skipped.
SMART_PLAYLISTS.SCHEDULE_ENABLED_DOC: If enabled, playlists are regenerated automatically once a day at the time below.
SMART_PLAYLISTS.RULES_SECTION_DOC: One playlist rule per line (up to 90 lines, in three toggleable pages of 30). Leave unused lines blank. Lines starting with # are comments. See the plugin's README for the full filter/sort syntax.
SMART_PLAYLISTS.TOAST_RUN_STARTED: Building playlists - this can take a while on first run or after adding many files...
SMART_PLAYLISTS.TOAST_RUN_ERROR: Playlist generation failed - check the log
